title: Sheherazaad releases debut folk-noir LP Khudgarzi
excerpt: Artist Sheherazaad returns with her debut full-length album Khudgarzi, featuring South Asian folk music sung primarily in Urdu.
body_html:
Artist Sheherazaad has returned with her debut full-length album, titled Khudgarzi. The new record follows her previous EP, Qasr, which was produced by Grammy Award winner Arooj Aftab.

Described as a genre-chaotic folk-noir project, Khudgarzi is primarily sung in Urdu. The album's instrumentation incorporates traditional South Asian musical elements, drawing specifically from Hindustani and Carnatic styles.
